rules.accepted_credit_types: Pharmacotherapeutics CE from a board-approved national certifying organization or board-approved provider; hours must be delineated on the certificate (CMEs accepted if pharmacotherapeutic hours are documented)
rules.alternatives: Nationally board-certified APRNs meet the RN license renewal CE by holding an approved certification; the pharmacotherapeutics hours apply only with prescriptive authority.
rules.audit_note: At least 3% of renewing RNs/APRNs audited; selected APRNs mail the CE Audit Verification Form and certificates for 12 pharmacotherapeutics hours.

topics.who: APRNs with prescriptive authority (each year, in their role and population foci)
APRNs with prescriptive authority and controlled substance privileges (drug diversion, best prescribing practices, addiction treatment); exempt if no controlled substances prescribed in the period

rules.notes: 6 contact hours of pharmacotherapeutics every year = 12 per 2-year license period. The one-time 3-hour controlled substance course counts toward the pharmacotherapeutics hours for the year it is taken. Biennial renewal online Oct 1 - Dec 31.
